Hosts that need a login, CAPTCHA or wait stay manual in your browser. 5. Validation & Install Verify everything is ready, then install automatically Key Features Smart Dependencies Pre-Install Validation Resolves and installs required mods in the correct order Catches compatibility issues before installation starts Checkpoint System Cross-Platform Back Next Activity Copyreport Save report... ModSync.rs_ Install mods in guide order Guide and settings Guide editor Return to wizard K1 * K2 Download Process Step 5 of 10 Fetch archives, then answer installer choices Downloads Download your mod files Peer sharing defaults to Race: Origin and Peer 2 base and 0 widescreen mods selected compete. Peer transfers use public proxies only and fail closed if no proxy works. Nothing downloads automatically. Select Fetch Downloads in the Downloads panel to acquire the missing archives of every selected mod into your workspace; archives already there are verified and kept. When enabled, discovery can fetch public proxy and Downloads continue while you read later pages, and the Downloads panel keeps their status. Changing the guide, selection or folders waits until downloads Finish. Run tracker lists. Sharing Off prevents peer discovery and validation after downloads Finish; installation still requires a Fresh validation. transfers. Changes apply to the next run. Each run reads saved settings; refresh here after edits outside the app. Refresh peer settings » Peer-sharing settings Peer: Fallback; upload cap 16 KiB/s. Fetch Downloads plans every selected mod's archives (base and widescreen), keeps verified archives already in the workspace and downloads the rest. Nothing starts until you select it. @ Fetch Downloads Open workspace No downloads started Direct archive download For provider pages, use the source links below and download in your browser. https://.../mod.zip Archive filename Expected SHA-256 (optional) Download archive » Selected mod sources Every archive is verified before it is kept. Progress shows measured bytes; a percentage appears only when the host reports a size. No downloads started Back Next Activity Copyreport Save report... Loaded 2 components
